settings.invite_share_message: I've been using TwinTracker to track everything for the baby — tap here to join me so we're both in sync 👶 https://www.twintracker.app/join?code={{code}}
settings.sleep_training_hint: Shows self-soothing wait times when baby is in the crib. Stage 1: 5–10 min. Stage 2: 20–45 min.
settings.live_activities_hint: Show automatic baby-card updates on the iPhone Lock Screen and Dynamic Island after feeds, pumping, naps, and sleep events. Turn off to clear active Live Activities.
settings.ios_live_activities_hint: Show automatic baby-card updates on the iPhone Lock Screen and Dynamic Island after feeds, pumping, naps, and sleep events. Turn off to clear active Live Activities.
settings.android_lock_screen_hint: Show a grouped TwinTracker household notification on the Android Lock Screen so you can glance at all household children when it makes sense. Turn off to stop Android lock-screen updates.
settings.sleep_training_checklist_blackout: Use a blackout room for naps and night sleep once baby understands day and night.
settings.sleep_training_checklist_swaddle: Double swaddle for sleep until rolling starts, usually around 4 months.
settings.sleep_training_checklist_noise: Keep white noise on for every sleep period.
settings.sleep_training_checklist_drowsy: Start drowsy-but-awake at 8 weeks for overnight sleep and around 3 months for naps.
settings.sleep_training_checklist_ghost: If you do an overnight ghost feed, keep lights out, skip the diaper change, and keep interaction minimal.
settings.sleep_training_schedule_stage1_bullet1: Keep the cycle between 2.5 and 3 hours.
settings.sleep_training_schedule_stage1_bullet2: If baby wakes before the 2.5-hour mark, try soothing before feeding again.
settings.sleep_training_schedule_stage1_bullet3: A later bedtime like 10 PM to 6 AM can be normal when newborn sleep is still consolidating.
settings.sleep_training_schedule_stage1_bullet4: Bedtime is the one feed that goes straight into sleep to signal nighttime.
settings.sleep_training_schedule_stage2_bullet1: Aim for two crib naps around 2 hours each on a consistent daytime schedule.
settings.sleep_training_schedule_stage2_bullet2: Use a short 5–6 PM catnap only until about 6–8 months, then phase it out.
settings.sleep_training_schedule_stage2_bullet3: Move bedtime toward 7 PM and protect a consistent morning wake time.
settings.sleep_training_schedule_stage2_bullet4: If naps fall apart after travel or disruption, return to crib-first reps and rebuild the rhythm.
settings.sleep_training_schedule_stage3_bullet1: Drop the morning nap and shift to one nap that starts in the 12 PM to 2 PM window.
settings.sleep_training_schedule_stage3_bullet2: Expect the transition week to be messy and use an earlier bedtime while the nap moves later.
settings.sleep_training_schedule_stage3_bullet3: Avoid accidental car naps near the old morning-nap time so the new crib nap can stick.
settings.sleep_training_schedule_stage3_bullet4: Once the transition settles, protect the single long afternoon nap as the main daytime sleep.
settings.sleep_training_waits_current_newborn_win: A gentle self-soothing window here is about 5–10 minutes of uninterrupted crying.
settings.sleep_training_waits_current_4_to_12_win: A gentle self-soothing window here is about 10–15 minutes of uninterrupted crying.
settings.sleep_training_waits_current_3_to_6_wind: A typical self-soothing window here is about 20 minutes of uninterrupted crying.
settings.sleep_training_waits_current_6_to_9_wind: A typical self-soothing window here is about 30–45 minutes of uninterrupted crying.
settings.sleep_training_waits_current_9_plus_wind: A typical self-soothing window here is about 45–60 minutes of uninterrupted crying.
settings.sleep_training_waits_current_support_1: Give your baby a real chance to settle before stepping in. Many babies fuss, protest, then drift off once they have a little space.
settings.sleep_training_waits_current_support_2: If the crying stops and starts again, reset the timer. Count only the uninterrupted stretch.
settings.sleep_training_waits_current_support_3: This can be emotionally hard to hear. Holding the boundary calmly is still responsive parenting when the sleep setup and timing are right.
settings.sleep_training_waits_current_support_4: If the window passes, respond consistently and calmly rather than changing the whole routine in the moment.
settings.sleep_training_notes_wake: Use a consistent wake time and avoid starting the day before it unless baby is truly up for the day.
settings.sleep_training_notes_crying: Short crying after put-down can be normal. Many babies settle inside their age-based window.
settings.sleep_training_notes_regressions: For regressions, travel, or disruptions, return to the same routine unless baby is actively sick.
settings.bedtime_hint: Target bedtime. Shown as a countdown when baby's last nap winds down. Stage 1 newborns: set to 10 PM.

meta.title: TwinTracker — Twin Baby Tracker App
meta.description: The baby tracker built for twins. Track feeds, naps, diapers, and growth for two babies — or one — with smart scheduling, household sync, and no clutter. Free on web, iOS & Android.
meta.keywords: twin baby tracker, tracker for twins, twins newborn app, multiples tracker, baby tracker, newborn sleep log, feeding tracker, twin parent app, nap tracker

landing.tagline: Built for twins. Works beautifully for one.
landing.hero_sub:
Baby care in black and white.
Simple, intuitive, no guessing.
Track feeds, stash, and milestones at a glance.
landing.feat_schedule_desc: Learns your baby's patterns. Tells you when to feed, nap, and change — no guessing.
landing.feat_sync_title: Built for Multiples. Works for One.
landing.feat_sync_desc: Log one baby and sync the other in a single tap — or track a singleton with the same calm, at-a-glance dashboard.
landing.feat_growth_desc: WHO percentile charts for weight and height. See how your babies are growing over time.
landing.feat_stash_desc: Track pumped milk, stash bottles, and stash-fed bottles with a live stash balance for fridge and freezer milk.
landing.feat_milestones_desc: Capture firsts alongside the daily logs so the moments that matter stay part of your baby's story.
landing.feat_i18n_desc: English, German, French, and Spanish. TwinTracker speaks your language.
landing.story_title: Built by a twin parent, for every parent.
landing.story_body: I was frustrated. Every baby logging app I tried was cluttered, slow, or completely missed what it's like to care for more than one child. So I built TwinTracker — first for my twins, then for any parent who wants a fast, secure, at-a-glance view of what their child needs right now. I use it every day.
landing.privacy_promise_intro: Your baby's data is among the most sensitive you'll ever share. Here's our commitment.
landing.privacy_promise_on_device_desc: Schedule intelligence and pattern recognition happen locally on your phone — your data never trains our models.
landing.privacy_promise_no_share_desc: Your information is never sold or shared with third parties.
landing.privacy_promise_your_data_desc: Export your logs or delete your account any time. No lock-in, no hoops.
landing.waitlist_body: TwinTracker for iOS and Android is coming soon. Leave your email and we'll let you know the moment it's live.
landing.waitlist_success_body: We'll email you the moment TwinTracker launches. Thank you for your interest.
